concepts.statement_en: Use confirmed health-center guidance rather than unverified messages.
Notice and address a service-setting risk within the BHW role.
Ask about the person’s needs and preferences before agreeing the next step.
Move a sensitive conversation to an agreed private setting and limit unnecessary disclosure.
Identify and address a participation or communication barrier without unfair exclusion.
Respect beliefs, identities and circumstances; avoid judgment or humiliation.
Identify avoidable delay and communicate a confirmed next step.
Coordinate relevant service contacts and handovers within the BHW role.
Reduce avoidable duplication and waste while maintaining access and safety.
Identify unneeded items for authorized removal.
Arrange needed supplies according to use.
Maintain cleanliness using the assigned procedure.
Use a consistent agreed workplace standard.
Carry out assigned responsibilities without repeated prompting.
Repeat and review the agreed housekeeping routine over time.
